title: Finite-coefficient etale tensor stability
statement: Let Lambda be a finite commutative ring and X any scheme. In the ordinary etale derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] of two bounded constructible finite-Tor complexes [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] is again bounded constructible finite-Tor. If the input Tor intervals are [a,b] and [c,d], the output interval is [a+c,b+d].

source.place: Existing complete source proof; no Lean edit or new hole.

proof.text: A finite ring is Noetherian. Tensor Tor sheaves of constructible sheaves are constructible, as seen on a finite local-constant stratification with finite module presentations. Truncation devissage gives constructible cohomology for the derived tensor of bounded constructible inputs. Finite Tor amplitude of either factor bounds this tensor above and below, and tensor associativity with a degree-zero sheaf adds the two Tor intervals. Combining these observations is exactly boundedConstructible_tensor followed by torAmplitudeIn_tensor in the existing source proof of constructibleFiniteTor_tensor.

theorem constructibleFiniteTor_tensor (X : Scheme.{u})
